about_the_game:
A DIRTY WAR FOR THE FUTURE

Corporations play god while the streets drown in chaos. Your father's disappearance drags you into a war between the Resistance, the fanatical Order, and the Prospect corporation. There is no "right" side here - only choices, consequences, and the price you are willing to pay.

🧠 UNFORGIVING TACTICS

Forget button mashing. Every move is the mathematics of survival.

  • Positioning is everything: Use full and partial cover, control lines of sight, and flank enemies.

  • Combat Physics: Destroy objects, blow up explosive barrels, and push enemies into hazard zones.

  • Squad Synergy: Combine abilities. Blind foes with a hacker so your stormtrooper can safely close in for the kill.

🧬 HUMAN ARCHITECT

You are not limited by classes. Your fighter is defined by what you install in them.

  • Flexible Progression: Combine marksman, medic, or pyromaniac skills however you like.

  • Cybernetics: Integrate combat implants: tactical optics to reveal weak spots, or a reinforced skeleton to crush enemies in melee.

  • Crafting: Scavenge rare components (cobalt, nano-gel) and engineer weapon prototypes in your own workshop.

🌃 THE CITY REACTS

It's not just a backdrop. The world changes depending on your actions.

  • Living Locations: From the neon-lit rooftops of the elite center to flooded catacombs and rusted factories.

  • Reputation System: Helped the bandits? You'll get a discount on the black market, but corporate patrols will shoot on sight.

  • Dynamic Events: Sudden enemy dropships, weather shifts, or an ally betraying you mid-mission.

🎮 DEMO AVAILABLE

Download the free demo and test the tactical combat:

  • Story Prologue - first campaign missions with branching choices

  • Full Tactical Combat - cover, AP, items, squad abilities

  • 8 Background Options - starting points for different builds

  • First Hub Location - vendors, events, first faction encounters

BE PART OF THE DEVELOPMENT

We are an indie team from Ukraine. Humanity Echo is created for those who value a true challenge and strategic depth. We are building this world together with players, so your voice carries weight. Don't just watch - influence the game's development!

🤝 Join our Discord: discuss balance and propose mechanics

✅ Wishlist Now: don't miss the release and launch discount

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Odesa, 2044. A cyberpunk metropolis in the crossfire of corporate wars. You aren't a hero - you're an engineer fighting to survive. Lead your squad in this turn-based tactical RPG with destructible environments. Install military implants and hack enemy networks. Every mission reshapes the city.
supported_languages: English, Ukrainian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese
